rows.question: Which listing is each supplied short link supposed to reach?
rows.known: Each link resolves to an Amazon product page with a 10-character ASIN; each token is 9 characters (P-01..P-05).
rows.missing: The intended ASIN or listing URL for each product.
rows.discover: Owner confirms the intended product for each link, or opens each link in Associates Central's link builder.

rows.question: Are the supplied short links valid Special Links from the enrolled Associates account?
rows.known: Policy requires Special Links to carry the Associates ID as a parameter (V-02). The links were not tested in an account.
rows.missing: Whether the links are credited to shopnow047c-20 and appear in tracking reports.
rows.discover: Run one test per product: click, confirm destination, check the tracking report. Then scale.

rows.question: Is shopnow047c-20 an active, enrolled Associates ID?
rows.known: Tracking ID given by owner. Policy example format is XXXXX-## (V-03).

rows.question: Can the site show prices or ratings?
rows.known: Policy limits price display (V-04). Listing pages show prices, but those are not confirmed as stable official values.
rows.missing: PA-API / Creators API eligibility and credentials.
rows.discover: Associates Central: check API access; decide whether to use it.

rows.question: What commission rate applies to these products?
rows.known: Rate schedule page exists but requires sign-in (V-11).
rows.missing: Category rates for Home & Kitchen (air fryers, thermometers).
rows.discover: Export the rate card after sign-in.

rows.question: Who is the author and what are their credentials?
Which five events should be measured?
rows.known: The brief refers to five defined events but does not list them. Five are proposed on the Measurement page.
rows.discover: Owner confirms or edits the proposed list.

rows.question: Is there any search or traffic demand for these topics?
rows.known: No search, traffic, or keyword data was available to this session. The four guide titles are working hypotheses from the brief, not measured demand.
rows.missing: Query volumes, impressions, clicks, and rankings.
rows.discover: Verify the site in Search Console after launch; review queries after 28 days; optionally use a keyword tool with an official data source.

rows.question: Does the product-quality or 'best' claim hold for any product?
rows.known: No product was tested. Only listing text is quoted.
rows.missing: Hands-on testing data, independent review data, or manufacturer test reports.
rows.discover: Commission testing or cite independent test reports with links.

rows.question: Is the disclosure wording and placement legally sufficient?
rows.known: Amazon's required statement is used verbatim (V-01). FTC placement guidance is followed (V-09).
rows.missing: Legal review of the overall disclosure set and any future endorsement context.

rows.question: What is the publishing cadence?
rows.known: No cadence was set by the owner.
rows.missing: Owner choice of cadence and capacity.
rows.discover: Choose from the options on the Suggestions page.

rows.question: What is the campaign's measured performance?
rows.known: No authorized first-party report has been provided. The ledger is empty.
rows.missing: Clicks, eligible sessions, orders, and dates.
rows.discover: Export Associates reports and add dated rows to the ledger with provenance.

rows.question: Is the 'Crisp & Done' brand available and safe to use?
rows.known: Checked only against the cited Amazon trademark rule (V-08).
rows.missing: Trademark registry search and domain availability.
rows.discover: Owner or counsel runs a registry search.

rows.question: Should the site host imagery, and of what type?
rows.known: No product images were used. Program Content rules restrict image use (Participation Requirements §6(a)).
